payload.title: Coordinate multiple classifiers in shared decision requests and independent flywheel sessions
payload.description: Use catalog classifier revisions and source-neutral item lists for live/replay sessions. Batch compatible classifiers in one decision request with scoped rubric/examples/questions and mapped outputs. Maintain independent heads, feedback and trigger/optimization state. Cache complete shared requests; count usage once. Connect catalog labels/explanations to optimization without future-label leakage. Existing arXiv worker is not completion of this general coordinator.
